items.summary: A security flaw has been discovered in samanhappy MCPHub up to 1.0.45/1.1.7. Impacted is an unknown function of the file src/utils/passthroughHeaders.ts. The manipulation of the argument passthroughHeaders results in information disclosure. The attack may be launched remotely. Upgrading to version 1.1.8 is recommended to address this issue. The patch is identified as 040f7b9ae004070bdfe5084cde6bc2c609f78e76. It is advisable to upgrade the affected component.

A vulnerability was identified in Termix-SSH Termix up to 2.9.2. This issue affects some unknown processing of the file /plugin-api/file-manager/transferToHost. The manipulation of the argument destPath leads to path traversal. The attack may be initiated remotely. The exploit is publicly available and might be used. The shortcut was removed in the standalone File Manager plugin v1.0.0 (transfer engine now always writes over SFTP) and in core v26.10.0. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A vulnerability was determined in jxxghp MoviePilot up to 3.1.2. This vulnerability affects the function WorkflowExecutor.restore_context of the file app/chain/workflow.py of the component Workflow Fork Endpoint. Executing a manipulation can lead to deserialization. The attack can be launched remotely. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. Upgrading to version 3.1.3 is able to resolve this issue. This patch is called 6034dcc880c13079aeb398dbe32c346ebcd3a6d2. It is recommended to upgrade the affected component.

A vulnerability was found in Sanluan PublicCMS 4.x/5.x/6.x. This affects the function TradeRefundService.updateAmound of the file publiccms-parent/publiccms-trade/src/main/java/com/publiccms/logic/service/trade/TradeRefundService.java of the component publiccms-trade. Performing a manipulation of the argument refundId results in authorization bypass. The attack can be initiated remotely. The exploit has been made public and could be used. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A vulnerability was identified in Linksys E8450 1.2.00.360516. Affected is the function strcpy of the file /www/cgi-bin/portal.cgi. Such manipulation of the argument hidden_timezone leads to stack-based buffer overflow. The attack can be executed remotely. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure but did not respond in any way.

A vulnerability was determined in WAVLINK WN536AX6-A V260507. This impacts the function host_black of the file /protocol.csp. This manipulation of the argument mac causes os command injection. Remote exploitation of the attack is possible. The exploit has been publicly disclosed and may be utilized. The vendor was contacted early about this disclosure.
